name: SPACEGODZILLA

words.SHOOT THE LEFT OR CENTER SHIELD: SHOOT THE LEFT SHIELD OR MASER

about: The C example SPACEGODZILLA rebuilt in blocks and taken deeper (PAD-658): Right ramps plant the crystals (two a crystal the first time, four the second, six the third), and three crystals start a 3-ball multiball in three stages: CRYSTAL TOWERS (the ramps and the Building, a super at the Big loop), M.O.G.U.E.R.A. (the shoulder crystals at the shields, every hit a spiral grenade raising the jackpots, the super twice its sum at the Godzilla target) and SPACE BEAST (his own music, the powerlines cut, FUKUOKA TOWER at the Building: three times the sum and every super before). Each super adds a ball. On a Pro the Maser target is the centre shoulder crystal.
lost: No points while the mode is not running: the C pays 250,000 a crystal times its number (250,000, 500,000, 750,000) as it is planted; the blocks' Score only scores while the mode runs.

The crystals are planted at the Right ramp, not locked at the Big loop after the powerlines light a lock (PAD-658: the powerlines are KING GHIDORAH's start, the Big loop KUMONGA's): no lock is lit, and only the full set (three crystals, waiting for the game's mode to end) chases purple at the Right ramp.

No badge for the super's 20 s window: the badge counts the mode's own clock, and this multiball has none, so the window shows as the line (SUPER JACKPOT: THE BIG LOOP) and its shot chasing white, blinking fast in its last 6 s (looked at once a second).
The super's added ball is asked as a multiball of one more ball than are in play (the blocks have no add-a-ball block), with its 10 s ball save.
Another mode of ours running does not stop the Right ramp planting crystals (the blocks cannot tell one of our other modes runs; the C waits for it). A multiball still stops it.
SpaceGodzilla arrives 3 s after the third crystal (PAD-658: its note is read first), where the C took 1.5 s.
The ending's line says how it ended (EVERY SUPER AGAIN after the finale, CRYSTAL SHARDS: HALF THE SUM otherwise) where the C counted 7 JACKPOTS  -  1 SUPER.
The ending stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.

No light show of its own at the start and the end where the game has none (the C falls back on its own when the game's Strobe storm or Blue fade will not play): the blocks play the game's (and the mode's own shows beside).
A tilt or the game moving on ends it as any blocks mode ends (the C also ends at once without its total).

The C's three multiballs in turn (CRYSTAL TOWERS, M.O.G.U.E.R.A., SPACE BEAST, one per start) are now the three stages of every multiball, and the C's first-time rule (one powerline lit every lock) is now one hit a lock.

intro.what: At 0:36:06 SpaceGodzilla descends through pillars of light with blue lightning onto Birth Island, lands, and crystals erupt around him in a white burst (one shot).

loop.what: At 1:16:27 Godzilla stands among glowing crystal towers in night Fukuoka as sparks fountain from their tips, then a wide shot of the whole blue crystal field glowing over the city (run of two shots, cut at 1:16:31.7).

jackpot.what: At 1:24:51 Land M.O.G.U.E.R.A. fires blue beams into a crystal tower and it bursts in pink fire and sparks (run of quick shots, same angle).

tower.what: At 1:19:23 Godzilla's blue ray sweeps across the night crystal field and the crystal towers explode in white and pink sparks and fire (one shot).

super.what: At 1:36:58 Godzilla fires his red burning spiral ray in close up and it slams into SpaceGodzilla in fire and white sparks (run of shots: cut at 1:37:00.8, then flash cuts during the hit).

won.what: At 1:37:21 SpaceGodzilla explodes in a huge pink and orange fireball over the city while Godzilla stands in silhouette (one shot).

lost.what: At 0:40:14 after SpaceGodzilla's corona beam hits him on Birth Island, Godzilla topples backwards into the smoke and lies on the ground (run of three shots, cuts at 0:40:16.8 and 0:40:17.9).

moguera.what: At 1:20:04 M.O.G.U.E.R.A. separates in close up, its head section lifting away from the body with its orange eyes lit, in the night sky (one shot).

grenade.what: At 1:27:04 M.O.G.U.E.R.A. fires its beam across the night city and it bursts in pink sparks on SpaceGodzilla among his crystal towers (run of quick shots).

beast.what: At 1:15:56.5 SpaceGodzilla's huge shoulder crystals blaze white as green lightning pours from him, then the lightning crackles round a Fukuoka tower block (run of two shots).

shatter.what: At 1:35:03.9 SpaceGodzilla's head and shoulders in close up as red fire flickers across him after Godzilla's ray strikes (one shot).

music.what: Main title march under the opening credits at 0:01:29, the theme that returns in the Birth Island battle with SpaceGodzilla at 0:38:43; orchestral, no dialogue.

lit.what: At 0:37:07.75 a glassy crackling crystal shimmer as crystal spires rise around Little Godzilla, clean start and stop.

lock.what: At 0:36:50.55 SpaceGodzilla shrieks in close up on Birth Island.

jackpot.what: At 1:27:27.35 a crackling energy blast with a shower of sparks as a lightning burst strikes Godzilla among the crystals.

tower.what: At 1:12:24.85 a big crash with debris and sparks as M.O.G.U.E.R.A. slams into the ground, decaying to quiet.

super.what: At 1:24:29.88 a sharp burst and a roar over a close shot of SpaceGodzilla's glowing shoulder crystals.

add.what: At 1:30:06.85 M.O.G.U.E.R.A. launches a missile from its side, a rocket blast and whoosh.

won.what: At 1:38:47.93 Godzilla gives his victory roar in close up after SpaceGodzilla is destroyed.

lost.what: At 1:15:24.27 Godzilla roars in pain as SpaceGodzilla's blue lightning strikes him.

moguera.what: At 1:20:05.45 the rushing mechanical roar of M.O.G.U.E.R.A. separating, falling away to quiet.

beast.what: At 1:27:38 SpaceGodzilla's harmonic cry in close up among the crystals.

shatter.what: At 1:35:04.38 a deep burst of flame on SpaceGodzilla as Godzilla's ray strikes, decaying away.

beast.what: Takayuki Hattori's battle score as Godzilla advances on Kagoshima at 1:04:21.7, orchestral, a 16.08 s loop found by the bed finder (seam chroma 0.585, self-check PASS).
